'Equipped' is a STATE (a creature with an Equipment attached, CR 301.5), not a creature subtype. This is a two-keyword grant that BareKeywordGrantRule (pri 967) declines (single kw group -> MapKeywordToStaticAbility('flying and haste')=null) and no other rule owns, so Dalakos was previously unparsed and the new rule (pri 975, fires first) NEWLY introduces a wrong parse.
items.notes: The Cloudshredder Sliver fixture itself is faithful (Sliver IS a subtype; flying as evasion CanBeBlockedBy Flying/Reach, haste as keywordAbility, both granted to Each Sliver-creature-you-control). The [A-Z][a-z]+ subtype capture is also under-guarded against Land/Red/Multicolored/Tapped/Modified single-keyword lines (Tatyova, Bloodmark Mentor, Maze cycle, Lost in the Maze, Kodama) — those reproduce BareKeywordGrantRule's own pre-existing subtype-treatment so are not NEW mis-captures, but confirm the guard should validate 'sub' against real creature subtypes (or denylist Equipped/Land/Modified/Tapped/color/'Multicolored').
